title: A pilot repository outside KRN delivers five tasks through krn lane run
body:
Why: every KRN task so far is KRN-on-KRN; both audits (Fable, Qwen 4) name an outside pilot as the real product test. Operator 2026-11-11 granted the lead the choice of pilot repository and its onboarding (memory:lead-decides). Decision record: .krn/runs/pilot/decision.md (pick: korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness at /mnt/storage/coding/krn/active/seo-audit).
Outcome: the pilot is onboarded with krn adopt through a PR in its own repository (never pushing its default branch, never editing the operator's checkout), krn lane run delivers 5 real pilot tasks, and their correctness is graded by hidden tests in the t-ahepzts grader shape.
Proof: 5 merged pilot PRs listed with lane $, lead turns and hidden-test verdicts in this task; Qwen N10 portability blockers (App token repositories:['krn'], hard-coded paths) fixed in KRN first.

Token scope (2026-11-11): scripts/github-app-token.ts mints for KRN_APP_REPOSITORY=<owner/name> via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/installation. Live: korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness answers 404, the App krn-works-delivery is not installed there; the operator installs it (repository-only selection) before krn lane run can push or ship. Remaining N10 items: Check aggregate name (pilot CI is 'CI'), origin/main assumption, npm run fast in lane-run.
Depends on the portability tasks t-9xwtz6f t-p226jft t-pvhs4eb  (operator 2026-11-13: KRN must work in any repository); add a second pilot in another stack (Python) graded the same way.
Portability tasks: t-9xwtz6f contract, t-p226jft Stop check, t-pvhs4eb lane, t-d25znwp adopt, t-0a9xgwe universal skills/rules.
